Here's a description of the line plots, following your guidelines:

The plots illustrate training rewards over a series of steps, for different models. The x-axis is labeled "Steps" and spans from 0 to 500, with a linear scale and regular tick labels every 100 steps. The y-axis is labeled "Training Rewards" and spans from 0.0 to 0.4, with a linear scale and regular tick labels every 0.1.  The first plot depicts three lines, described by a legend in the upper right. A blue line with circular markers represents "Llama-On-Policy-Easy," starting at approximately 0.20 at 0 steps and rising to approximately 0.35 at 500 steps, exhibiting fluctuating behavior throughout. A teal line with circular markers represents "Llama-LUFFY-Easy," beginning at around 0.22 at 0 steps and ending at roughly 0.32 at 500 steps and showing an undulating pattern. A red line with triangular markers represents "Llama-LUFFY-Easy," starting at around 0.21 at 0 and reaching approximately 0.36 at 500, exhibiting an undulating pattern. The second plot shows two lines using the same axes. A blue line with circular markers shows "Llama-On-Policy-Hard," starting at approximately 0.03 at 0 steps and increasing to roughly 0.18 at 500, with noticeable fluctuations. A red line with triangular markers representing "Llama-LUFFY-Hard" starts at approximately 0.04 at 0 steps and rises to roughly 0.18 at 500 steps, demonstrating a fluctuating behavior.
